title: Absolutely top tour and organization!!
text:
This trip is highly recommended. Great organization, very comfortable and modern coach with a first-class driver.
Everything was there, equipment and kayaks in top condition. We had the great pleasure of spending the day with our guide Ola. Ola was just great. He explained everything perfectly, was always there for you and made this experience simply wonderful! All the pictures and even the link for a great playlist (music during the bus ride) are free. There are absolutely no nasty surprises.
Thank you Ola!!!

title: An incredibly fun way to spend the day
text: We had a great trip kayaking, snorkeling, and cliff jumping.  Tim and Ola were incredibly fun and thoughtful.  All the details were taken care of and explained perfectly to a very diverse group of travelers.  I highly recommend this trip, it's an ideal way to spend a day away from the city.
author: L7830CMveram

title: Nice way to spend an extra Day in Barcelona
text:
This tour is light on the kayaking and includes a lot of extra time in the beachside town on Costa Brava. The total kayak time probably doesn’t exceed an hour, total snorkeling and cliff jumping time is probably around 2 hours. The rest of the time is unstructured free time in the local beach and is a bit long. The whole trip probably could have been a couple hours shorter. It includes photos taken by the kayak guide by goPro, which is a nice feature. The bus ride out and back takes up a couple of hours all together. The guides are both friendly and accommodating.
